# openai_workspace_workload_identity_federation_rule (Resource)

Beta. Map an external workload to an existing principal in a ChatGPT workspace for Codex. Changing the workspace, provider, or principal replaces the rule; matcher and permission changes update it in place. Internal bindings are resolved automatically.

Authentication: Set the workspace_admin_api_key provider attribute or OPENAI_WORKSPACE_ADMIN_KEY environment variable for the workspace API audience; with a custom workspace_base_url, set the workspace_admin_api_key provider attribute explicitly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openai_workspace_workload_identity_federation_rule" "example" {
  workspace_id                  = "workspace_123"
  workload_identity_provider_id = "idp_123"
  principal_id                  = "user_123"
  external_subject              = "repo:example/codex-ci:environment:production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `principal_id` (String) ID of an existing active user or service account in the workspace.
- `workload_identity_provider_id` (String) ID of the workspace-owned workload identity provider.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the owning ChatGPT workspace.

### Optional

- `access_token_lifetime_seconds` (Number) Lifetime of the exchanged credential. Defaults to 3600 seconds.
- `audiences` (List of String) Allowed audiences for the external identity.
- `claims` (Dynamic) Exact claim matches for the external identity.
- `condition` (String) CEL condition evaluated against the external identity.
- `description` (String) description
- `enabled` (Boolean) enabled
- `external_subject` (String) Subject matched against the external identity. Supply a subject, claims, or a condition.
- `name` (String) Display name. Defaults to the principal's name when the rule is created.
- `scopes` (List of String) Scopes for the exchanged Codex credential.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) created at
- `id` (String) Workload identity federation rule ID.
- `owner_id` (String) Owner ID of the rule's provider.
- `owner_type` (String) Owner type of the rule's provider.
- `updated_at` (Number) updated at
- `workload_identity_federation_rule_id` (String) Workload identity federation rule ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = openai_workspace_workload_identity_federation_rule.example
  id = "workspace_123/idp_123/id_123"
}
```
